features: Blazing 200MB/s Read Speeds — Next-Level USB 3.2 Performance – The EnStick 64GB achieves read speeds of up to 200MB/s using USB 3.2 Gen 1 technology, enabling lightning-fast transfers of HD movies, 4K clips, and large RAW photo files. Spend less time waiting and more time doing.

Works Everywhere — Smart TV, Laptop, Desktop, Car Stereo – Whether you're loading content onto your Smart TV, presenting from your laptop, or playing music in your car, the EnStick 64GB connects effortlessly to all USB 3.2, 3.0, and 2.0 ports with plug-and-play simplicity.

Metal-Reinforced Durability with High-Quality IC Chipsets – The premium metal body resists impact, heat, and daily stress, while EVM-grade IC chipsets maintain stable, consistent read/write performance — tested for operating temperatures from 0°C to 65°C and storage from -40°C to 85°C.

64GB of Versatile High-Speed Storage – Carry your complete project files, photo collections, music libraries, and video content in one compact drive. The 64GB capacity strikes the perfect balance between portability and storage headroom for everyday professional and personal use.

10-Year Warranty — Long-Term EVM Reliability – Every EVM EnStick 64GB comes with a 10-year manufacturer warranty, reflecting EVM's commitment to building high-quality storage products that stand the test of time.
